text: This tower was leaning before it was even finished. Pisa started building it in eleven seventy three. Five years in, at floor two, it started sinking into soft ground. Work stopped for decades, because of wars. When building restarted, it was still tilting. So they built the upper floors taller on one side, to curve it back. It took about two hundred years. The mistake made it famous. Would you have kept building?
